text:
Challenge the **onboarding load** assumption first: Olumi estimated **4 experienced developer-hours/week**.

- It is the only stated downside that can quickly erase six‑month delivery gains, especially when hiring two developers.
- Your actual capacity to mentor, review work and absorb new hires may differ sharply by role and by the first few weeks.
- All current figures are Olumi estimates, not facts you supplied; delivery capacity and technical-guidance quality are equally influential, but onboarding is the most likely short-horizon constraint.
